title: When Business is Battle: Inside the Boardrooms of the CEOs that Survived the Storm

thesis: The episode features a conversation between Ben Horowitz and Navon co-founder Ariel Cohen about how two CEOs navigated severe crises, specifically losing all revenue due to the pandemic. The discussion highlights the critical importance of hiring the right type of employees and the difficult decisions required to stay in the market when facing unprecedented challenges.
